title: A nonzero integer multiplicity cycle supported in an n-plane has the whole plane as support
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, every C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n, ℝ^P = Euclid P) and every orthonormal family τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) in ℝ^P (Orthonormal ℝ τ), with Q := span{τ_1, …, τ_n} (Submodule.span ℝ (range τ)): if C is integer multiplicity, ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C), spt C ⊆ Q, and M_W(C) ≠ 0 for some open W ⊆ ℝ^P (C.massOn W ≠ 0), then spt C = Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), 1 ≤ n → Orthonormal ℝ τ → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → BoundaryVanishes C → C.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ C.massOn W ≠ 0) → C.support = (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))
